node.title: Tiger Team Compression Model
node.reading:
The later decision-before-discovery analysis separates learning a fact from constituting an operating responsibility. Use a provisional, reversible scope for inquiry where appropriate. The move into focused execution should state which uncertainties remain accepted and which decisions the sponsor has actually authorised.

Transformation is treated as a changing compression problem. Different phases require different structures: uncertainty must first be framed, execution then compressed, and institutional adaptation supported without losing coherence.

Large-scale transformation projects rarely fail because organisations lack intelligence, technology or resources.

At different stages of a transformation, the problem itself changes. Sometimes the challenge is uncertainty. Sometimes the challenge is execution. Sometimes the challenge is institutional adaptation. Most methodologies attempt to apply a single organisational logic to all three phases simultaneously.

A governance-heavy structure slows intervention. A purely execution-focused structure loses strategic optionality. A highly exploratory architecture layer becomes disconnected from operational reality. Over time, coordination overhead grows faster than operational understanding.

relations: Upstream work should produce a focusable mission and explicit residual uncertainty before execution is compressed, with the cost of that preparation visible.
Suficiente depende del alcance y del riesgo; no se propone un umbral universal ni una fase de diagnóstico sin límite.
Successful engineering needs an institutional handover that preserves ownership, maintenance capacity and recognition after the intervention team leaves.
Una asignación de dueño no demuestra valor realizado y puede fallar si se impone antes de reconstruir la capacidad.
JUBAP's expansion-and-filtering sequence offers a practical comparison for moving from architectural optionality to a focusable engineering mission.
No identidad formal entre JUMP y el Compression Model ni afirmación de que el equipo deba activarse antes de resolver sus condiciones de mandato.
Selective coupling offers a way to discuss the transition between focused intervention and organizational absorption without treating immediate full integration as the default.
El parentesco no demuestra que los casos Tiger Team hayan sido diseñados como pruebas del régimen de Part IV.
The HRIS case illustrates a bounded architecture mandate whose successful exit is a usable transition to scaled delivery, rather than ownership of the entire rollout.
La entrega del blueprint no prueba implementación completa ni realización de las estimaciones económicas del portfolio.
The frontier cycle raises a governance question for compression and expansion: how can scaling retain the ability to explore without treating every expansion as extraction?
Son tipologías distintas. Ninguna permite clasificar automáticamente todo rollout como neutralización de la frontera.
Phase changes can be reviewed as role and mandate transitions, distinguishing permitted realignment from a new objective or contract.
Comparación de gobierno; el perfil de software de 2026 no reemplaza contratos o decisiones humanas del Tiger Team.
